acceptanceCriteria: An archived post-finish pull request with no active Contract produces a ready ordinary-repository selection with no Contract identity and does not fail as unresolved.

A push to the protected default branch does not require a semantic Release tag or release source revision; it resolves merged PR identity when available and otherwise produces the ordinary repository route.
Exactly one matching active Contract remains selected with its identity and base; multiple matches remain fail-closed with a structured ambiguity failure.
Explicit immutable-tag recovery remains active-Contract-only and still rejects missing or archived recovery identities.
Regression tests prove the archived PR, ordinary push, active binding, ambiguity, and explicit recovery boundaries without invoking expensive repository gates.
The CI route consumer accepts a null Contract base for ordinary merge selection and delegates base computation to the typed repository quality route.
goal: Allow archived Work Item pull requests and ordinary main pushes to run the ordinary repository route without guessing or reusing an active Contract, while preserving explicit Contract selection and fail-closed ambiguity.
intent: Make CI selection honor the documented finish/archive-before-PR lifecycle and keep merge pushes separate from Release tag recovery.
